item.title: Baby boy surrendered at Safe Haven Baby Box in Abilene, TX
item.description: Officials in Abilene, Texas have announced the safe surrender of a child in a Safe Haven Baby Box located in one of the city's fire stations. The surrender marks just the second time a baby box has been utilized in the state.

item.title: UK House of Lords committee debates extreme bill allowing abortion to birth
item.description: (Right to Life UK) Peers lined up on Monday 2 February to back a major bid to overturn the abortion up to birth clause in the Crime and Policing Bill, and to reinstate the requirement for in-person consultations with a medical professional prior to an abortion taking place at home.

item.title: New Mexico Senate committee advances bill to repeal abortion reporting requirement
item.description: Lawmakers in the New Mexico Senate Health and Public Affairs Committee advanced a bill on Monday that would repeal a law requiring the reporting of abortion statistics in the state — a law that legislators admit hasn't been enforced since 2019.

item.title: Texas man sues California abortionist under new state law
item.description: A Texas man is suing an out-of-state abortion pill provider and is the first citizen to leverage House Bill 7, which empowers Texas citizens to sue abortion providers up to $100,000.

item.title: Four women are suing Arkansas over its pro-life law, but did they really 'need' abortions?
item.description: Four women have joined a lawsuit against Arkansas over the state's pro-life law protecting most preborn children from abortion. The law, Act 180, allows induced abortion — the direct and intentional killing of a child in the womb — only when the mother's life is considered to be at risk.

item.title: West Virginia Senate committee advances bill prohibiting abortion pill distribution
item.description: Members of a West Virginia Senate committee advanced legislation Tuesday that would protect women by outlawing the mailing and distribution of chemical abortion drugs within the state.

item.title: Virginia lawmakers advance bill to legalize assisted suicide
item.description: Lawmakers in a Virginia Senate subcommittee advanced a bill Tuesday that would legalize assisted suicide in the state.

item.title: Chile moves towards outlawing surrogacy
item.description: Chile has taken a pivotal step towards forbidding surrogacy, advancing a bill that would ban and penalize the practice. The legislation continues its way through Parliament toward a final vote.

item.title: Woman praises 'abortion pill reversal': 'I'm so happy to be a mom'
item.description: (Pregnancy Help News) Circumstances, pressure, and fear often drive a woman to abortion. But Abortion Pill Reversal offers a second chance at choice.

item.title: 'It's surreal': New York family welcomes rare quintuplets
item.description: A New York couple unexpectedly saw their family size jump from four to nine, after conceiving quintuplets — an experience doctors describe as extremely rare.
